command: Use config/qwen2_1p5b_target_shape.json as the only shape and bias authority. Add a reusable QKV post-projection path that applies FP32 Q/K/V bias to widths 1536/256/256 in 16-lane chunks, then maps each of 12 query heads to one of two 128-lane KV heads with fixed six-way GQA multicast. Independently verify chunk tails, head boundaries, query-to-KV mapping, backpressure and stable sideband tags. After this gate, build restartable target-node segments in fixed order: RMSNorm/QKV, RoPE/streamed M-L-O/O-L, OProj/residual, second RMSNorm/gate-up-SiLU-product/down/final. Each segment must consume the preceding frozen output hash. Only after every payload segment passes, run the unchanged controller in full trace/count mode and mark those cycles separately from payload numerics.
fixed_order: QKV bias and six-way GQA mapping
final residual and target-shape cycle report
success_condition: Every target-shape payload segment consumes and emits frozen hashes, all intermediate nodes agree with the operation-order model, QKV bias and GQA mapping are exercised, no score matrix is materialized, and full trace/count cycles are explicitly separated from segmented payload numerics; CPU 8-25, max j4 and 10 GiB cap remain enforced.
failure_policy: Do not infer model dimensions from memory, switch revision, use hidden256 evidence as target-shape proof, replace payload outputs with a software bypass, report analytical tile counts as RTL-measured cycles, relax the first mismatch, materialize the score matrix, or start q128 before target-shape closure.
